title: Te Tāone Ngaro o te Rangatiratanga Kore e Taurite
intro: I mua, i te ao whānui, i rongonuihia tētahi iwi nui mō ōna hanganga teitei e toro atu ana ki te rangi. Heoi, i raro i tēnei rangatiratanga, ka tipu ake tētahi whakahē pakari - he whakahē ki te whakarongo ki te kaiwhakatūpato atua i tukuna mai i roto i te hapori tonu. Ka puta wawe mai i te whakapehapeha me te whakahihi he whiu kāore i kitea e te whenua, e te rangi rānei.
clues: I noho rangatira tātou i runga i te whenua whānui i mua, i whakamanamana ki te kaha i whakapono tātou kāore e taea e tētahi atu iwi te rite.
I rongonui tō mātou kingitanga mō ngā hanganga teitei me ngā pou nunui i tū motuhake puta noa i ngā whenua katoa e mōhiotia ana.
I whakatika mai tētahi kaiwhakatūpato nō tō tātou ake hapori, e akiaki ana i a tātou katoa kia ngohengohe ki te Kaihanga Kotahi anake.
I whakakahoretia e mātou te karere i tukuna mai ki a mātou, ā, i whakakahore ki te whakarērea te ara i riro mai i a mātou.
I tukua mai he hau riri nui, he hau nui whakaharahara ki a mātou, ā, kāore he ārai mō mātou.
I mahue iho mātou, ano he pūtake nikau kua pokaia, i marara noa atu, kua warewaretia, hei akoranga mā ngā whakatupuranga katoa i muri mai.
